Irish Mathematical Olympiad1992 Q9 asks only for the pentagon area; the FIST version shown here also asks for infinitely many noncongruent examples.

IrMO 2016 Q2 repeats the converse direction of this configuration: given the equal distances and unequal adjacent sides, determine angle A. That shorter appearance was assessed at 4.5; the full 2009 equivalence shown here is rated 5.
The same two-part colouring problem appeared in the Armenian National Mathematical Olympiad 2025, Grade 11–12, Q6.
The same one-way telephone-information problem appeared as CMO 1971 Q10. Both appearances are reconciled at difficulty 4.5.
The same triangle bisection problem appeared in the Croatian Mathematical Competition 2019, County Round, Year 1 Variant A, Q4. Both appearances are reconciled at difficulty 3.5.
